reflections.notebook:
Opponent tendencies: Garchomp is Adamant Life Orb, spams Earthquake, uses Protect to scout. Rotom-Wash is Modest Sitrus, uses Thunderbolt/Hydro Pump offensively, Will-O-Wisp available.
